scriptConfig.expression: const e = ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view?.editor; try { await activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.writeText(e.getSelection()); e?.focus(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); new Notice('Error: Please check console for details'); }

const e = ntb.app.workspace.activeLeaf.view?.editor; try { let rs = e.replaceSelection; let text = await activeWindow.navigator.clipboard.readText(); if (text) rs.apply(e, [text]); e?.focus(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); new Notice('Error: Please check console for details'); }
